about_the_game:
The end of the world doesn’t always come the same way! The “By Various Means” map pack celebrates the myriad of potential ends of the world.

Stay warm in the new ice age with Ice Age, stay cool amidst volcanic devastation on Lava Roads, stay above water during a great flood with Great Flood, keep your head down with The Crater, beat back an aggressive mother nature with Nature Overgrowth, or resist alien invasion with Area 52.

Unlocking this pack enables you to host games for all players of Journey Quest, even those who have not unlocked the pack themselves.
